title: Underived coefficient square coherence for commutative rings
statement: For any commutative ring Λ, any Cartesian square of schemes and any étale module sheaf F on the lower-right corner, the component of comparisonSquareData (ModuleCat Λ) commutes.

proof.text: Apply the already proved generic comparison_coherent to ModuleCat Λ and project its Cartesian-square clause at X′, X, Y′, Y, g′, f′, f, g, cs and F. The proof is available through a proof-only import all; its category hypotheses are satisfied for modules over any commutative ring, without a finiteness instance.

proof_origin.place: comparison_coherent, third conjunct; reused through import all in the E1 second reading

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_square_component_of_commRing
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (cs : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ComparisonSquareComponent
      (comparisonSquareData (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g' f' f g cs) F
